messages.subject: Re: Installing RODBC error
parts:
I think there's a lot more we need to get this working. It looks like RODBC provides the connection from R to ODBC in general, but ODBC is just a general protocol for talking to databases--you need an ODBC driver for MS SQL. On Linux it looks like the free one is called FreeTDS, so I've installed that on glimmer. However it looks like you also need to configure FreeTDS to know about your server in /etc/freetds/freetds.conf... which we can do, I guess... it's just weird as this is a global config file that needs to be edited by the administrator every time. I don't know if we'd offer this as part of our hosting service but I'm definitely interested to see how we can get this to work for future reference.

Do you want me to add an entry in /etc/freetds/freetds.conf for you?
